Question: Show load readings above 80 MW.

rank_trace.sql:
SELECT sr.reading_id, sr.asset_id, sr.reading_value  
   FROM sensor_readings sr  
   WHERE sr.sensor_type = 'load' AND sr.unit = 'MW' AND sr.reading_value > 80  
   ORDER BY sr.reading_value DESC;

SELECT sr.asset_id, sr.reading_value, a.location_id  
   FROM sensor_readings sr  
   JOIN assets a ON sr.asset_id = a.asset_id  
   WHERE sr.sensor_type = 'load' AND sr.unit = 'MW' AND sr.reading_value > 80  
   ORDER BY sr.reading_value DESC;

SELECT sr.reading_id, a.asset_id, sr.reading_value  
   FROM sensor_readings sr  
   JOIN assets a ON sr.asset_id = a.asset_id  
   JOIN work_orders wo ON a.asset_id = wo.asset_id  
   WHERE sr.sensor_type = 'load' AND sr.unit = 'MW' AND sr.reading_value > 80  
     AND wo.fault_code = 'LOAD'  
   ORDER BY sr.reading_value DESC;
